ceiling_directive: Prove that the channelwise lower-bound witnesses arise from admissible joint panel laws on positive-marginal-probability query sets, yielding the matched frontier over the causal panel class rather than only over the constructed union of labelled fixed-query kernels.
improvement_directive: Lift the treated, clustered-spacing, iid-spacing, and donor two-point constructions to explicit joint panel-law submodels and prove matching conditional MSE and honest-length lower bounds for the induced causal target. This would turn the current almost-everywhere upper transfer into a two-sided panel-law frontier on the same estimand.
critique: The matched three-channel MSE and expected-length rates are proved over a bespoke union of labelled fixed-query conditional-kernel classes, not over the joint causal panel-law class. For actual panel laws, the note proves identification and transfers only the upper risk, coverage, and expected-length conclusions at marginal-almost-every query; it expressly supplies no panel-induced converse. The deterministic fixed-design result is additionally an idealized known-specification experiment in which the rule receives X, z0, and Sigma, so it does not close that causal-panel gap. Consequently, the title-level sharp causal frontier is under-delivered: what is settled sharply is the constructed statistical kernel experiment, while the causal panel result remains one-sided despite the framing's accurate disclosure of that limitation.
